info.name: Clio API Documentation Activities Activity Descriptions API
Return the data for all ActivityDescriptions

params.name: created_since
params.description: Filter ActivityDescription records to those having the `created_at` field after a specific time. (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).

params.name: fields
params.description: The fields to be returned. See response samples for what fields are available. For more information see the [fields section](#section/Fields).

params.name: flat_rate
params.description: Filter ActivityDescription records to those that have a flat rate, or not.

params.name: ids[]
params.description: Filter ActivityDescription records to those having the specified unique identifiers.

params.name: limit
params.description: A limit on the number of ActivityDescription records to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 200. Default: `200`.

params.name: page_token
params.description: A token specifying which page to return.

params.name: rate_for[user_id]
params.description: User id for rate calculation. If not provided, the user associated to the API request is assumed.

params.name: type
params.description: Filter ActivityDescription records to those of a specific type.

params.name: updated_since
params.description: Filter ActivityDescription records to those having the `updated_at` field after a specific time. (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).

params.name: user_id
params.description: The unique identifier for a single User. The keyword `null` is not valid for this field. The list will be filtered to include only the ActivityDescription records with the matching property.
